scheme.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
scheme.implementing_agency: State/UT Governments, District Administration, Gram Panchayats/ULBs
scheme.description: IGNDPS is a component of NSAP providing monthly pension to BPL persons with 80% or more disability. Central Government contribution: Rs 300/month for age 18-79 years, Rs 500/month for age 80 years and above. Disability must be certified by a competent medical authority. Pension disbursed through DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account.
scheme.voice_summary: The disability pension is for people aged 18 to 79 with 80 percent or more disability, from below poverty line families. The central share is 300 rupees a month.
eligibility: Applicant must be aged 18 years or above
Applicant must be aged 79 years or below (Rs 500/month for 80+)
Applicant must have 80% or more disability certified by competent medical authority
Applicant must belong to a BPL household
application_process: offline: Obtain application form from BDO / Gram Panchayat / District Social Welfare Office.
offline: Attach disability certificate / UDID card, BPL ration card, and bank passbook.
offline: Submit to BDO or District Disability Rehabilitation Centre.
online: Visit the NSAP portal or state social welfare portal.
online: Select 'Apply Online' -> 'Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)'.
online: Upload disability certificate (80%+ severe/multiple disability or UDID card) and BPL proof.
online: Provide Aadhaar and bank account details.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar number or enrollment slip for identity verification

documents.name: Proof of Age (18+ years)
documents.description: Birth certificate, school certificate, EPIC, or medical officer age certificate

documents.name: Disability Certificate (80%+ disability)
documents.description: Disability certificate issued by competent medical authority certifying 80% or more disability

documents.name: BPL Card / Certificate
documents.description: BPL ration card or certificate issued by designated authority

documents.name: Bank / Post Office Passbook
documents.description: Active bank or post office savings account passbook with IFSC/branch code

procedure_steps.text: Obtain application form from BDO / Gram Panchayat / District Social Welfare Office.
Attach disability certificate / UDID card, BPL ration card, and bank passbook.
Submit to BDO or District Disability Rehabilitation Centre.
Visit the NSAP portal or state social welfare portal.
Select 'Apply Online' -> 'Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)'.
Upload disability certificate (80%+ severe/multiple disability or UDID card) and BPL proof.
Provide Aadhaar and bank account details.

catalog_descriptions.en: The disability pension is for people aged 18 to 79 with 80 percent or more disability, from below poverty line families. The central share is 300 rupees a month.
catalog_descriptions.hi: दिव्यांगता पेंशन गरीबी रेखा से नीचे के परिवारों के 80 प्रतिशत या उससे अधिक विकलांग लोगों के लिए है। केंद्रीय हिस्सा 300 रुपये प्रति माह है।
catalog_descriptions.ta: 18 முதல் 79 வயதுக்குட்பட்ட 80 சதவீதம் அல்லது அதற்கு மேற்பட்ட ஊனமுற்றோர், வறுமைக் கோட்டிற்குக் கீழே உள்ள குடும்பங்களைச் சேர்ந்தவர்களுக்கு ஊனமுற்றோர் ஓய்வூதியம் வழங்கப்படுகிறது. மத்திய அரசின் பங்கு மாதத்திற்கு 300 ரூபாய் ஆகும்.
